title: Aromatic Molten Italian Ricotta Cannoli
description: A nostalgic Italian dish with a twist, featuring citrusy and spicy flavors, this flexitarian friendly dessert is a must try. The combination of ricotta cheese, thai red curry paste and citrus zest creates a unique taste experience.

ingredients.name: Ricotta cheese
ingredients.notes: drained and dried with paper towels

ingredients.name: Cannoli shells
ingredients.notes: dried in a low oven to crisp

instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees to dry the cannoli shells.
In a bowl, mix the ricotta cheese, thai red curry paste, confectioners sugar, lemon zest and orange zest until well combined.
In a separate bowl, beat the egg for the egg wash.
Brush the egg wash on the cannoli shells to seal them.
Fill a piping bag with the ricotta mixture and pipe into the cannoli shells.
Place the filled cannoli shells on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the cannoli shells in the preheated oven for 10 minutes to warm the filling.
While the cannoli is baking, prepare the brine by boiling the water and then letting it cool.
Once the cannoli is done, let it cool for a minute before serving.
Serve the cannoli with the brine on the side for dipping.
